intent.title: Rework stray paths instead of stopping

verify_turn/5, guard_rework/6, and guard_rework_prompt/3 implement bounded cleanup and restoration

scenarios.reason: Inspected the guard rework implementation and all four scenario variants; the focused scenario suite passed 35 tests, including path listing, session reuse, mode restoration, notes, and provider retry behavior.

evidence.locator: @guard_reworks and guard_rework/6 record each occurrence and stop after the exhausting entry
stray-file-budget-spent tests assert two guard resumes, three entries, untouched offline accounting, and independent offline retry budget

scenarios.reason: Verified the dedicated two-rework limit and separate verification budget in code and tests; both budget cases passed.

evidence.locator: GuardedPaths.invalid/1, same_policy/1, and protected path table classify terminal categories and preserve messages
terminal-guard-failures-stay-terminal tests cover policy, protected, Approved-copy, failed-turn, provider-marker, nested cache, and terminal-precedence cases

scenarios.reason: Inspected category classification and the complete terminal fixture matrix; all terminal and accepted residual cases passed without unintended resumes.

evidence.locator: updated expectations retain integrity, git-policy, and protected-path assertions while changing ordinary stray behavior
shared-file and root-policy result-shape assertions were updated without removing Approved mutation coverage
core integrity expectations cover the new guard-violation outcome

scenarios.reason: Reviewed each changed existing test file and ran the related suite; assertions now reflect the approved rework and terminal rules, with Approved mutation coverage retained.

scenarios.reason: Inspected shared-file event handling and ran all fixture cases; events are recorded once, exclude hiding is terminal, failed-turn events are retained, and Candidate policy changes still stop.

scenarios.reason: Verified controller-phase Approved-copy additions stop with integrity and do not resume the Developer; both target outcomes passed.

scenarios.reason: Inspected packet construction, reviewer guidance, and packet fixtures; reworked paths are visible with digest-bound locators, large lists remain bounded, and clean attempts carry an empty field.

work-turn-notes-survive-rework tests verify one Jev request, combined headers, packet persistence, and cannot-comply behavior

scenarios.reason: Verified note retention and combination in implementation and both Jev outcomes; the focused tests passed.

rework-still-runs-every-input-check tests cover protected-path precedence and retained-record tampering during a waiting Developer

scenarios.reason: Inspected check ordering and ran both terminal-precedence fixtures; Approved additions do not hide protected or input-integrity findings, and no resume occurs.
